hero.eyebrow: Carpentry & renovations on the Gold Coast
hero.headline: Carpentry, repairs and renos on the Gold Coast, done to a high standard.
hero.subhead: Small jobs, door and lock repairs, feature walls, barn doors, decks, fencing and renovations from Coomera to Coolangatta. Send through the job and get a clear written quote.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Gold Coast Carpentry assistant. Got a small job, a repair or a reno in mind? Tell me a bit about it and I'll help you get a quote or book a time with Darren.

about.headline: Small job or full reno, it's done properly.
about.body: Most people want the same things from a chippy: someone who turns up on time, prices it fairly and finishes it to a high standard, even on the small stuff. Every job runs that way, from a sticking door to an apartment renovation.

cards.title: The small jobs nobody wants
cards.body: Door repairs, lock replacement, rotten timber and the minor repairs that pile up.

cards.title: Rooms that need a lift
cards.body: Feature walls, barn doors, pantries and joinery that change how a room feels.

cards.title: Bigger projects
cards.body: Decks, fencing and renovations, with the associated trades organised for you.

about.closing: Not sure if it's worth a call? Send it through and Darren will let you know.

problems.headline: Getting a chippy on the Gold Coast to turn up shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: Nobody rings back about the small jobs, and the big ones take weeks to quote.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A number that keeps climbing once the work starts.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Tradies who don't show on the day and jobs that drag on.

points.title: Sloppy finishing
points.body: Gaps, rough edges and fittings that don't sit right.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a tradie just to get a clear quote.

services.title: Small jobs & repairs

services.title: Feature walls, barn doors & joinery
services.body: Feature walls, barn doors, pantries and fridge cavities, finished precisely.

services.title: Decks, fencing & renovations
services.body: Decks, fencing and renovation work, with quality finishes and associated trades organised.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Quote it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your quote
steps.body: Send a few details and photos with the form or give Darren a ring.

steps.title: Look & clear quote
steps.body: We have a look, talk through the options and put the price in writing.

steps.title: Punctual, tidy work
steps.body: On time, respectful of your home or building rules, and cleaned up after.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We walk the finished job with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

realReviews.author: L T
realReviews.text: Darren and his team did a job at our apartment in Broadbeach. From quote to finished product I couldn’t fault them. Our building has quite a few rules & regulations. These guys abided by all of them and were respectful in the way they went about the job. Building manager was also impressed. I’ve had trades for a few Reno type jobs and these guys are the best I’ve used. Quality finishes & fittings, attention to detail and associated trades they engaged were all of a similar high standard. Very impressed with the whole process and speed they worked at. Easily the best team on the coast, highly recommend

realReviews.author: Ken Salale
realReviews.text: Darren and his team are highly skilled craftsmen who display their skills and expertise through their work. Very easy to deal with, reliable and professional. I would not hesitate to recommend their work. Thank you again.

realReviews.author: The Barefoot Folk
realReviews.text:
The absolute best builders you’ll find.
They went above and beyond with everything they did, and really heard our concerns. We had absolutely 0 issues and would highly recommend them to everyone who needs quality, punctual and friendly builders.

finalCta.headline: Got a job that needs a good chippy?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or give Darren a ring. We'll come and have a look if needed, and send a written quote with the scope and price.
Yes. Door repairs, locks, timber replacement and minor repairs are a big part of the work.
The whole Gold Coast, from Coomera and Helensvale through Southport, Surfers Paradise, Broadbeach and Robina down to Burleigh and Coolangatta.

faq.q: Can you work in apartment buildings?
faq.a: Yes. We work within body corporate rules and building requirements, and keep the building manager in the loop.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a time to look at the job.
